fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami banking and municipal debt, business conditions, and transportation and shipping delays affecting boatbuilding on the Miami River. Reports discuss a new comprehensive harbor proposal for Biscayne Bay involving Miami Beach, Terminal Island, and Virginia Key, including a proposed causeway and airport. Additional pieces address destruction of slot machines by police, traffic safety near the Miami Avenue bridge, post office site selection, dairy distribution and milk costs, and hurricane warning visibility; the issue also contains a society column and local notices/advertising.
